notice: Assistant-authored development set (2026-11-16) of widely documented facts, for measuring coverage and agreement during development. Not held-out, not human-audited; results are diagnostics, not accuracy estimates. 'accept' lists every status consistent with the label (CONTRADICTED and SUPERSEDED both mean the claim does not hold now).

long_texts.text: The Panama Canal opened in 1914 and connects the Atlantic and Pacific oceans. It was handed over to Panama at the end of 1999. Today the canal is widely considered the most impressive engineering project of the twentieth century. Ships pay tolls to use it, and traffic is expected to double by 2040.
